text:
Type: mosaic ball table lamp
Use: light on a side table, nightstand or console; living room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, coastal, rustic
Materials: coconut shell mosaic body, woven raffia shade
Colors: dark brown, warm cream, natural straw beige
Shape: round ball base with brick-pattern mosaic, wide tapered textured drum shade, wooden finial, chunky
Feel: warm, earthy, tropical
Goes with: rattan, dark wood, linen, warm neutrals; bohemian, tropical or coastal rooms

product.name: Pinzon Coconut Ball Table Lamp
product.description: Bold and rustic, the Coconut Ball table lamp features real coconut shells in a mosaic tile effect Coconut shell orb base; burlap drum shade; gold cord Requires 1 bulb up to 100 watts; UL listed; 3-way switch for adjustable lighting Arrives assembled for immediate enjoyment Measures 26 inches high by 18 inches wide; weighs approximately 10 pounds
